programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties
programme.desc: Anne Marie Kerr misstänker att hennes bror Alans död inte är en olycka och bestämmer sig för att utreda saken. Hon börjar arbeta för den mäktiga familjen som kan vara inblandad i Alans död. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby
programme.desc: En föräldralös (Mel Harris) strävan att spåra sitt förflutna börjar med ett barndomsfoto av henne själv bredvid en sällsynt speldosa och leder henne till en förförisk skattjägare. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: At the Midnight Hour
programme.desc: Liz, en vacker barnflicka, ger ny mening åt Richard Keatons liv, en änkeman som blivit vetenskapsman, och hans begåvade son Andy. Liz liv hotas när hon kommer för nära sanningen. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Awakening
programme.desc: När en prisjägare, som spårar en av hennes hyresgäster, övertygar Sara McAllister att samarbeta med honom, påbörjar de ett äventyr tillsammans i den farliga världen av internationell spionage och kärlek. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Waiting Game
programme.desc: Sarah och Amy, bästa vänner sedan universitetet, anordnar sin första konstutställning i en liten stad i New England. När gåtfulla främlingar kommer in i deras liv och romantik uppstår utvecklas det utmaningar. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter

programme.title: Harlequin: Loving Evangeline
programme.desc: När Robert får veta om sin brors båtolycka ger han sig ut för att hämta kroppen och möter Evie Shaw, ägare till marinan där hans bror hyrde båten. Han blir besatt av sin brors misstänkta död ... och av Evie. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Recipe for Revenge
programme.desc: Cateringfirman Carly Westin går med på att förbereda en festmåltid för en vän som vill imponera på en man. Men paret blir dödat när hon är i köket. När polisutredaren Jack blir inblandad måste han skydda Carly. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: När den oroliga Dominique ber sin bokälskande syster Kimberly att anta rollen som en glamorös parisisk modell i en månad, tvekar Kimberly. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: När Lisa vaknar upp på sjukhuset minns hon ingenting: vem hon är, hennes man Pauls avsikt att skilja sig från henne eller att hon blev svårt misshandlad och lämnad att dö i en gränd. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Case 39
programme.desc: Oscarbelönade Renee Zellweger spelar huvudrollen i en här skrämmande övernaturliga thrillern om en socialarbetare som har tilldelats det ovanliga och kusliga fallet med Lilith Sullivan...en flicka med ett märkligt och mystiskt förflutet.

programme.title: Byzantium
programme.desc: Två mystiska kvinnor lever som vampyrer i skuggorna. När deras förflutna når dem utspelar sig en episk kamp mellan överlevnad och det förtrollande mysteriet med evigt liv.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Monsters are Due on Maple Street
programme.sub-title: The Monsters are Due on Maple Street
programme.desc: Paranoia strikes the residents of Maple Street when they believe human-looking aliens have invaded the neighborhood.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Changing of the Guard
programme.desc: An elderly private school teacher wonders if his life has meant anything as he contemplates suicide on Christmas Eve and is reminded by former students that he has, indeed, had an impact on their lives.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Probe 7, Over and Out
programme.desc: The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Encounter
programme.desc: A World War II veteran and a Japanese-American gardener battle each other over a war that ended more than 20 years ago.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Odyssey of Flight 33
programme.desc: Passing through the sound barrier a commercial airliner inadvertently travels back in time.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Time Enough at Last
programme.desc: A bank teller, Henry Bemis, longs for time alone to read books. He gets his wish...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mirror
programme.desc: After a poor but ambitious Central American farm worker overthrows his country's tyrannical leader, he believes he sees assassins everywhere. A look in the mirror reveals his most dangerous enemy.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Stop at Willoughby
programme.desc: Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Prime Mover
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler cajoles his friend to use his telekinesis to affect the results of the gambling tables in Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Big Tall Wish
programme.desc: An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Whole Truth
programme.desc: A used car salesman buys a car that dooms him to tell only the truth.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Uncle Simon
programme.desc: Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Kind of a Stopwatch
programme.desc: Patrick Thomas McNulty, a long-winded and self-absorbed know-it-all, is given a fantastic device which brings literal meaning to the expression "stop the world; I want to get off."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Will the Real Martian Please Stand Up
programme.sub-title: Will the Real Martian Please Stand Up
programme.desc: Following a frantic phone call about a crashed spaceship, two policemen try and determine who among the passengers of a bus at a snowed-in roadside diner is from another world.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dust
programme.desc: In a tragic, western town, a desperate father begs for clemency as his son is slated to die for an accident he could not have prevented.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programme.sub-title: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programme.desc: Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Twenty-Two
programme.desc: While in the hospital recovering from overwork, Liz Powell keeps dreaming about going down to the hospital morgue.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Most Unusual Camera
programme.desc: When three dum-dum crooks get ahold of a camera that takes pictures of the future, they set out to make a quick fortune with their new toy.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Cavender is Coming
programme.desc: Cavender, an angel trying to win his wings, tries to help down-on-her-luck Agnes, who has just been fired.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Escape Clause
programme.desc: A hypochondriac exchanges his soul for immortality and indestructibility.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: John Wayne plays Hondo Lane, a cavalry rider who becomes the protector of Angie Lowe as well as a father figure to her boy, Johnny. Angie, determinedly awaiting the return of her husband, refuses to leave their homestead despite the growing danger.

programme.title: In Old California
programme.desc: The Duke plays a young, ambitious pharmacist who moves into a brawling frontier town but locks horns with a local crime lord, bent on keeping the town for himself.

programme.title: The Lonely Trail
programme.desc: After serving with the Union army, John Wayne returns home to be recruited by the governor of Texas to rid the state of crooked carpetbaggers.

programme.title: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: Producer-director Otto Preminger’s epic treatment of the bombing of Pearl Harbor details the devastating attack on the Hawaiian naval base as well as the explosive, behind-the-scenes stories.

programme.title: Red River Range
programme.desc: The cattlemen's organization calls upon the Three Mesquiteers to pose as outlaws to round up cattle thieves who cleverly cover their tracks and vanish.

programme.title: Westward Ho
programme.desc: A young boy sees his parents killed and his brother kidnapped by outlaws, while traveling west on a wagon train. As an adult, he leads a vigilante band seeking the outlaw band, even though his brother is now their scout.

programme.title: Flame Of Barbary Coast
programme.desc: A cowboy competes with a gambling tycoon on the Barbary Coast for the hand of a beautiful dance-hall queen.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: John Wayne plays Hondo Lane, a cavalry rider who becomes the protector of Angie Lowe as well as a father figure to her boy, Johnny. Angie, determinedly awaiting the return of her husband, refuses to leave their homestead despite the growing danger.

programme.title: In Old California
programme.desc: The Duke plays a young, ambitious pharmacist who moves into a brawling frontier town but locks horns with a local crime lord, bent on keeping the town for himself.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Westernstjärnan Bud Spencer spelar en godhjärtad men järnnävad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby. Ett stort bananföretag vill exploatera byn, och när Joe sätter sig på tvären bestämmer sig företagsledaren – en gangster – att sätta dit honom.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: Miami Supercops
programme.desc: Här kommer ännu en actionspäckad komedi från den dynamiska duon Hill och Spencer. I "Miami Supercops" ser vi våra hjältar jaga både brottslingar och 20 miljoner dollar som stals vid ett rån för ett par år sedan.

programme.title: Legend of the Demon Cat
programme.desc: Filmen kommer från den BAFTA-prisbelönte regissören Chen Kaige och utspelar sig under Tangdynastin. En demonkatt dyker plötsligt upp och stör friden i staden Chang'an och orsakar en rad märkliga händelser.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Westernstjärnan Bud Spencer spelar en godhjärtad men järnnävad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby. Ett stort bananföretag vill exploatera byn, och när Joe sätter sig på tvären bestämmer sig företagsledaren – en gangster – att sätta dit honom.

programme.title: Supersnutarna
programme.desc: Matt och Wilbur är två hårdslående bråkmakare, men med hjärtat på rätta stället. Efter ett misslyckat rånförsök i Miami hamnar de av misstag på stadens polisskola.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: Dom kallar meg Trinity - Djävulens högra hand
programme.desc: Han har en käft lika väloljad som hans revolver. Han säger att han är en fredens man - men vem vågar tro honom? Hans namn är Trinity - Djävulens högra hand.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Nikkos wants a spectacular 1968 Mustang Fastback resto-mod. The all-metal masterpiece catches the eye of someone who wants it at any cost. Jim and Arlene want to enjoy their 45th anniversary in the same 1969 Firebird they rode in on their wedding day.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and team at Muscle Cars of Texas go under the hood of the 69 Malibu. The 63 Z06 factory race car, you have to see what it takes to make this race car look like it came out of the factory. Tagging and bagging time on the 72 Corvette.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Arnold brings Dan two interlocking projects. He wants FantomWorks to transform his 1946 Ford Panel Wagon into a classic tour-mobile, and he also wants Dan to fix the 1941 Harley Flathead motorcycle that will ride in the back.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Cap'ing-off the Challenger
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Brothers Jacob and Paul’s 1965 Chevy Impala nicknamed the Night Prowler would have been better named the Night Slug. Don shows up with a 1967 Corvette and a massive list of work that he wants done. Dan doesn’t know which is worse: the list, or the car.

programme.title: The Ride Life
programme.desc: Despite a troubled past of poverty and invasions, Korea has emerged as a car building power-house. Through its unheralded and talented-loaded car scene, Sung reconnects with the land of his birth and finds peace with his estranged mother.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Daniel wants FantomWorks to swap out the V6 of his 1968 Mustang Convertible with the V8 from a donor car. Stacia and Eugenia need Dan’s help to transform their quirky 1962 Citroen 2CV from a ‘problem child’ to a reliable car.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: When the 1941 Buick Coupe rolls into FantomWorks, it is the worst possible combination: a very difficult car and very demanding owner. Janelle wants her KZ-750 transformed into a cool stripped down ‘café’ bike – a challenge for FantomWorks new bike shop.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Kansas City Royals pitcher Tim Collins wants a ‘super-fast’ 1968 Mustang, but Dan has to first undo a nightmare combination of bad repairs and unsafe systems. Bob needs a FantomWorks reality check to get his beloved 1950 Willy’s Jeep back on the road.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: A 1917 Overland will be FantomWorks oldest restoration, if they can solve this jigsaw puzzle of rotted wood and rusted steel. Dan buys a 1968 Camaro on the internet for his wife, Malissa, and finds out that the car is in extremely poor condition.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team are getting the sound system ready inside the 1969 Mustang Malicious Intent. The 1950 Ford has miles of wiring to install.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Tom and Patti want to drive their 1967 Amphicar on land and water, but the hybrid boat-car has problems from stem to stern. Doc Pellerin hasn’t started his ultra-rare Austin 10/4 in years. He needs Dan to get it running for a major car show in four days.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Mike wants Dan to make his prized Mach 1 even more of a muscle car. Richard brings FantomWorks the first ‘his and hers’ restoration – a Sunbeam Tiger and a Fiat Spider – but as Dan soon discovers; the challenges of the two cars are not equal.

programme.title: Jet Truck
programme.sub-title: You Play With Fire, You Might Get Burned
programme.desc: Tensions mount in Cayuga as a frightening crash occurs on the drag strip moments before Chris is set to perform his incredibly dangerous first night race of the season.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Mickey’s 1970 Chevelle is perfect, but he wants FantomWorks to tear it apart and upgrade everything to make it his own. Thom’s 1963 Studebaker is a project car with a nightmare combination of leaks, bad parts and a rusted-out floor held together by glue.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Firepower Un-Boxed
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: 72 Charger SE Resurrected
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Michael wants a new convertible top for his 1953 Morgan, but the Fantomworks team has no reference, no template and no anchor points. Butch entrusted his 1969 Camaro to a restoration rip-off artist. Can Fantomworks fix the worst work they’ve ever seen?

programme.title: Reaching for the Moon
programme.desc: När den amerikanska poeten Elizabeth Bishop drabbas av skrivkramp i början av 1950-talet bestämmer hon sig för att resa till Brasilien. Där träffar Elizabeth arkitekten Lota de Macedo Soares och de blir snart attraherade av varandra.

programme.title: Thanks For Sharing
programme.desc: Adam (Mark Ruffalo) har just firat 5-årsdagen som 'nykter' sexmissbrukare, då han möter Phoebe (Gwyneth Paltrow) som han inleder en häftig flirt med.

programme.title: Nina Forever
programme.desc: Efter att flickvännen Nina dött I en bilolycka misslyckas Rob med att begå självmord. När han börjar komma över sorgen träffar han en ny. Men Nina kan inte finna ro på andra sidan. Hon plågar dem varje gång de har sex.

programme.title: About Hope
programme.desc: Thomas McKenzie har letat efter den perfekta kvinnan i hela sitt liv. När han träffar två kvinnor som väcker hans intresse lär han sig att den kärlek vi söker inte alltid är den kärlek som vi behöver.

programme.title: A Kind of Magic
programme.desc: Häxrådet förväntar sig att Matt gifter sig med häxan Lizzie men han träffar en annan – Sara. Då slutar hans magiska krafter fungera. Sara däremot upptäcker att hon fått dem.

programme.title: Dear Frankie
programme.desc: En kärleksfull mamma (Emily Mortimer) undanhåller sanningen om hans far från sin unge son genom att anlita en stilig främling (Gerard Butler) för att posera som pojkens pappa.

programme.title: My Bakery in Brooklyn
programme.desc: Vivien och Chloe har fått ärva sin tant Isabelles bageri. Chloe vill ha en ny image och servera nya grejer medan Vivien vill se till att ingenting förändras. Det hela urartar till en stenhård maktkamp med hjälp av allt mer kreativa och absurda knep.

programme.title: Carmen & Lola
programme.desc: Sjuttonåriga Carmen är redan förlovad. Hon förväntas snart gifta sig, få många barn och leva som hennes stora romska släkt alltid har gjort i Madrids förorter. Men när Carmen träffar sin fästmans kusin, den sextonåriga Lola, förändras allt.

programme.title: 900 Seconds with...
programme.desc: An exclusive interview looking back on Tony Knowles' career, his biggest matches, and memories from the snooker world.

programme.title: The Creator Clash
programme.desc: At the semi-final, Sara Guzo and Reanne Evans face Pieface23 and Dennis Taylor in the best of three frames.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Closing the Ring
programme.desc: The Western Allies secure supply routes that will allow them to enter Germany, and the Ardennes counter-offensive fails. The Red Army advances rapidly. The SS implements the Holocaust.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS stands for terror and the murder of millions. Documentary about the history of a symbol that represents murder.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”.

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.sub-title: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer SV
programme.desc: År 1945 fördes världen in i atomåldern. Med sin roll som bombens fader befäst blev Oppenheimer alltmer oroad över den potentiella fara som vetenskapliga uppfinningar kunde utgöra för mänskligheten.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I en kapplöpning med tiden korsade över 800 privata båtar Engelska kanalen för att rädda de förlistade soldaterna från infernot på Dunkerques stränder. Se enskilda veteraners extraordinära hjältemod i ett slag som förändrade andra världskrigets gång.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: In Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler's secret agenda is to rid Germany of Jews. By 1938, after creating work schemes and rearming, he orchestrates "The Night of Broken Glass," burning 1,000 synagogues and killing 91 Jews, preparing for further aggression.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police
programme.desc: In Ukraine and Lithuania, Nazi invaders were welcomed as liberators. In Lithuania, Antanas Gecas led a militia that executed hundreds of Jews. Ukrainian nationalists participated in pogroms slaughtering 34,000 Jews in two days.

programme.title: Execution
programme.desc: A bounty killer, Clips, has been for a long time on the trail of John Cooler, an elderly bandit whose head hangs a bounty of twenty thousand dollars. John is also wanted by the Mexican Juarez and his gang.

programme.title: Scalps
programme.desc: The commander of a Texan fort in the Civil War refuses to surrender to the Northerners, and tries to buy the local Indian tribe chief's daughter.

programme.title: Gunsmoke
programme.sub-title: Gunsmoke II: The Last Apache - Part 2
programme.desc: Retired Marshal Matt Dillon discovers that a long-lost love of his has been kidnapped by a fierce warrior chief of the infamous Geronimo and has to snatch two imprisoned Apaches from jail in order to arrange a swap for his former lover.

programme.title: Death Valley Days
